newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends merging finance firms.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends merging finance firms.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Friday suspended share trading of CMIC Finance and Securities Plc, Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc and Nava Finance and Securities Plc after the three firms announced a merger plan on Thursday.
The three firms on Thursday signed a memorandum of understanding to merge and announced a plan to apply for a new commercial banking licence.
The exchange said it also suspended trade in CMIC's warrants.

The exchange earlier halted trading in the three firms' shares during the Thursday afternoon session as they announced the alliance. The halt was changed to suspension which started in the Friday morning session. No indication was given when it will be lifted.
The central bank has strongly encouraged consolidation among Thailand's 91 finance and securities firms to boost their competitiveness.
